semantic_summary: Environment Agency Pollution Inventory and UK PRTR are high-value facility/reported-release sources, but individual pollutant rows must retain method, unit, year, facility and geometry semantics.
NAEI point-source data provide known-location/grid-reference evidence but may combine reported, estimated or modelled values and therefore require method labels.
EPR industrial-site datasets are facility/permit binding evidence and do not themselves provide emissions quantities.
Incinerator annual monitoring packages are measurement candidates but require row-level extraction and validation before promotion.
UK ETS factors, MRV guidance and reporting workflows are accounting inputs/controls rather than observations.
Landfill methane monitoring standards and technical equations remain method/threshold evidence until actual measured inputs and geometry are present.
Direct 2024 UK PRTR CSV extraction was attempted through two clients and failed without fabricating any facility row.
